findings.evidence: Lines 127–130, 186–190, and 205–208 assume only `IsOpen V` and nonemptiness of `V ∩ sphere c r`, which permits a disconnected union; `Mathlib/Analysis/SpecialFunctions/Complex/Circle.lean:475` provides the established `Circle.centeredArc` terminology.
findings.fix: Either require an arc/connectedness condition or rename all three declarations using the literal hypothesis, e.g. `..._of_eqOn_inter_sphere` and `not_eqOn_const_inter_sphere_of_injOn`.
findings.issue: The names `eqOn_const_ball_of_eqOn_const_arc`, `eqOn_ball_of_eqOn_arc` (line 186), and `not_eqOn_const_arc_of_injOn` (line 205) call `V ∩ sphere c r` an arc, although no connectedness hypothesis is imposed; Mathlib’s actual circular-arc API uses parameterized `Circle.centeredArc`.

summary: The public API uses “arc” for an arbitrary relatively open subset of a sphere, which may be disconnected and is not standard arc terminology.
